summary: Independently verified the Astra annulus 3-colouring candidate. Nine half-open 40-degree sectors starting at 0, colour = sector index mod 3, on the open annulus 0.99<|z|<1.01. Proved the angular dichotomy exhaustively over all 18 ordered same-colour sector pairs: same sector gives Delta<40 deg, distinct same-colour sectors give Delta in (80,160) deg, and no same-colour pair lies in the forbidden band (40,80). Wraparound handled by m=(l-k) mod 9 and folding with 360-d; boundaries by the half-open convention; unequal radii enter the distance formula explicitly. Rigorous rational bounds for cos 40 obtained from 8c^3-6c+1=0 using strict monotonicity on (1/2,1) plus exact sign tests at 383/500 and 767/1000, giving 1-cos40 <= 117/500 and 1-cos80 >= 411711/500000; no floating point in any decision. Case A distance squared <= 1194517/2500000 = 0.4778 < 1; Case B >= 4035179511/2500000000 = 1.6141 > 1. Sampling circles with |x|<0.005 and |r-1|<=0.005 lie in the annulus, and that lemma is TIGHT because the two 0.005 losses sum to exactly the annulus half-width 0.01. A standalone exact verifier reproduces every step with exit 0.

Wraparound via m=(l-k) mod 9 and 360-d folding; boundaries unambiguous because sectors are half-open.

GRADE [P]+[C] Rigorous bracket cos 40 in (383/500, 767/1000) from f(c)=8c^3-6c+1 with f'(c)=24c^2-6>0 on the interval and exact sign tests f(383/500)=-5613/15625000<0, f(767/1000)=967663/125000000>0. Derived 1-cos40 <= 117/500 and 1-cos80 >= 411711/500000. No sampled decimals.

GRADE [P]+[C] Distance bounds with unequal radii: |z1-z2|^2 = (r1-r2)^2+2r1r2(1-cos Delta). Case A (Delta<40) <= 1194517/2500000 = 0.4778068 < 1; Case B (Delta>80) >= 4035179511/2500000000 = 1.6140718 > 1. Margins 0.5222 and 0.6141. Hence no two same-coloured annulus points are at distance exactly 1: the colouring is PROPER on the annulus.

GRADE [P]+[C] Sampling-circle containment: for |x|<0.005 and |r-1|<=0.005 every point with |z-x|=r has 0.99<|z|<1.01; in particular the unit circle about any |x|<0.005 lies in the annulus. Noted that the lemma is TIGHT: the two 0.005 losses equal the annulus half-width 0.01, so both conditions must be strict.

GRADE [C] preserved, NOT upgraded: S3 (940 vertices, 5119 edges, 166-point non-clique overlap, 307 genuine cross edges, verified 5-colouring, chi=5) remains SELF-CHECKED. No external all-pairs audit of S3 has been performed; it is not accepted as externally verified.
conjectures: The annulus colouring is local and needs no conjecture; its correctness is proved. What remains open in this programme is not the annulus but whether any local proper colouring of this type can be transported, and nothing here bears on that.

The tightness of the sampling-circle lemma (0.005 + 0.005 = 0.01) suggests that any transport construction using unit circles about centres of modulus below 0.005 is operating exactly at the boundary of validity; slack would have to come from a smaller centre bound, not from a smaller radius tolerance.
S3 remains the only structurally nontrivial seed in this record, but it is self-checked only; an independent all-pairs audit is the outstanding obligation before it carries any weight.

escalation.obstacle: Find a unit-distance graph with a genuine forced-equal distinct pair at k=5 (which by the corrected lemma requires chi>=5). Two seeds are now excluded by certificate. The open question is what structural feature makes the 5-colouring space rigid on a pair, given that richness of the colouring space defeated both seeds.
escalation.definitions: Unit-distance graph: finite graph with an injection into R^2 such that uv is an edge iff |u-v| = 1. Proper k-colouring: c(u) != c(v) on every edge. Forced equal at k: G is k-colourable and G plus the edge pq is not; the added edge is a combinatorial disequality constraint and is never a unit edge for a non-adjacent pair. Coordinates in Q(sqrt3,sqrt5,sqrt11), basis {1,3,5,11,15,33,55,165}, denominators dividing 288.
escalation.hypotheses: Exact real-algebraic coordinates; induced (all-pairs) edge set verified; k = 5; chi(G) >= 5 required for non-vacuity.
escalation.attempted_approaches: Common-neighbour palette excluders (Theorem B caps at 2 colours); clique-sum gluing (Theorem A); complete no-forcing certificates for H (553 vertices, 34 witnesses) and for H union (H+tau) (1048 vertices, 34 witnesses, 1048 unique signatures); adaptive equal-signature refinement driving survival sets to zero twice.
escalation.expected_useful_output: Either a forced-equal pair at k=5 with exact coordinates and a validated proof certificate, or a third seed that also resists, in which case the informative quantity is which invariant of the surviving classes differs between seeds; neither cross-edge count nor chromatic order has been shown to control rigidity.
